name: Pen holder with servo lift (pen-up / pen-down)
source: Typical printed plotter pen holder with an SG90 lifting arm; dimensions typical, not measured
notes: Carriage-mounted holder: a 14 mm clip holds a marker (use pen-marker-whiteboard) vertically; an SG90 at the side swings a lever to lift it 5 mm. Two M3 holes in the back plate (30 mm apart, along Y) bolt it to the XY carriage. SG90 screws: 2 pilot holes on a 27.5 mm line.
